description: Retried toggling nanoex off after waiting out the ~2 minute lockout from 02 (triggered by the official app writing on menu close, per Kevin). Succeeded this time.
notes: Confirms the request contract works for toggling nanoex specifically (isolated field change via the coordinator-style read-modify-write).
